description: A muted olive-green long crossed-front steppe coat or deel with overlapping diagonal closure and simple brown-gold geometric borders along the neck, front edge, cuffs and hem. A cream inner tunic shows at the neck and wrists. A broad dark brown woven-looking sash wraps the waist with long patterned fringed ends hanging down the front. Loose brown trousers are tucked into tall dark brown boots with subtle diagonal decorative seams. The cloth is matte and visibly textured; exact fibre composition cannot be confirmed. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
